+    def _is_all_or_any_call(self, call):
+        """Check if a call is to all() or any() with a comprehension."""
+        if not isinstance(call.func, ast.Name):
+            return False
+        if call.func.id not in ("all", "any"):
+            return False
+        if len(call.args) != 1:
+            return False
+        arg = call.args[0]
+        # Check if the argument is a comprehension (GeneratorExp, ListComp, SetComp, DictComp)
+        return isinstance(arg, (ast.GeneratorExp, ast.ListComp, ast.SetComp, ast.DictComp))
+
+    def _unroll_all_or_any(self, call, assert_lineno, assert_col_offset):
+        """
+        Unroll an all() or any() call with a comprehension into for loops with assertions.
+        
+        This converts:
+            assert all(predicate(x) for x in iterable)
+        
+        Into:
+            for x in iterable:
+                assert predicate(x)
+        
+        Returns a list of statements to replace the assertion, or None if unrolling is not possible.
+        """
+        is_any = call.func.id == "any"
+        comp = call.args[0]
+        
+        # Extract the element expression and generators
+        if isinstance(comp, ast.GeneratorExp):
+            elt = comp.elt
+            generators = comp.generators
+        elif isinstance(comp, ast.ListComp):
+            elt = comp.elt
+            generators = comp.generators
+        elif isinstance(comp, ast.SetComp):
+            elt = comp.elt
+            generators = comp.generators
+        elif isinstance(comp, ast.DictComp):
+            # For dict comprehensions, we use the key
+            elt = comp.key
+            generators = comp.generators
+        else:
+            return None
+        
+        # For any(), we need to negate the condition
+        if is_any:
+            # Convert any(predicate(x) for x in iterable) to
+            # not all(not predicate(x) for x in iterable)
+            # But for simplicity, we'll just negate the element
+            elt = ast.UnaryOp(ast.Not(), elt)
+        
+        # Build the assertion statement for the element
+        assert_stmt = ast.Assert(elt, None)
+        
+        # Wrap it with the generators and their conditions
+        body = [assert_stmt]
+        
+        # Process generators in reverse order to build nested loops
+        for generator in reversed(generators):
+            # Add if conditions in reverse order
+            for if_clause in reversed(generator.ifs):
+                if_stmt = ast.If(
+                    test=if_clause,
+                    body=body,
+                    orelse=[]
+                )
+                body = [if_stmt]
+            
+            # Create the for loop
+            for_loop = ast.For(
+                target=generator.target,
+                iter=generator.iter,
+                body=body,
+                orelse=[]
+            )
+            body = [for_loop]
+        
+        # Set line numbers
+        for stmt in body:
+            set_location(stmt, assert_lineno, assert_col_offset)
+        
+        return body
+
